description: Ingress-only scanner networks whose scanning activity is documented by the operator itself (official scanner ranges or self-describing netblock remarks). Entries are reviewed individually; anything unsupported by a primary source is quarantined in list_audit.json. These sets MUST NOT be referenced from output/forward chains: an ingress scanner address says nothing about what the host may talk to.
review_methodology: Each CIDR checked against the provider's own published scanner documentation (Censys opt-out page, Cortex Xpanse scanning-activity reference, Rapid7 Sonar about page) or the org's self-description in RIPE/ARIN registry remarks. RIR allocation, PTR records, AS-SETs, or community reputation alone are NOT accepted as proof of scanner role.

censys.name: Censys internet scanners (officially published scan ranges)
censys.notes: Ranges verified verbatim against Censys's published scanner list on 2026-11-01. IPv6 narrowed from legacy /48 and /40 declarations to the exact /80 scan prefixes Censys publishes. 74.120.14.0/24 and 192.35.168.0/23 no longer appear in the official list and are quarantined.

cortex_xpanse.name: Palo Alto Cortex Xpanse general internet scanners (officially published)
cortex_xpanse.notes: Only 144.86.173.0/24 appears in Xpanse's published scanning-activity ranges as of 2026-11-01. 144.86.174.0/24, 144.86.175.0/24, 199.30.26.0/24 and 199.30.27.0/24 are absent (legacy Expanse allocations / tenant-specific AST ranges) and are quarantined.

rapid7_sonar.name: Rapid7 Project Sonar scanners (officially published ranges)
rapid7_sonar.notes: Replaces the previous entirely incorrect rapid7_sonar entries (71.6.216.224/27, 71.6.232.0/24, 146.185.183.0/24 DigitalOcean VPS space, 2604:a880::/32 DigitalOcean IPv6). This list is exactly what Rapid7's Sonar page publishes as its scan sources as of 2026-11-01.

research_scanners.name: Self-disclosed internet measurement scanners (Recyber, Driftnet)
research_scanners.notes: Operator's own RIPE netobject remarks state these blocks are non-hostile research/measurement scanning ('RECYBER PROJECT NETBLOCK: This net-block is not trying to hack you'; Driftnet internet-measurement.com). Self-description in the operator's own registry object is accepted as primary documentation of scanner role.
